title: Blind-Geothermal Geochemical-Disequilibrium, Tufa-Decontaminated Outflow Back-Projection, GeoDAWN 400 m Flight-Line-Notched Upward-Continuation & Active Slip-Deficit Structural Conduit Synthesis
physical_mechanism: 75% of Great Basin geothermal systems are blind (lack Quaternary surface scarps due to rapid alluvial-fan burial), yet leaking deep thermal fluids preserve high Na-K-Ca cation and chalcedony/quartz equilibration temperatures (120-265 C) inside cool/warm valley wells and springs (temp_c 15-45 C), creating a diagnostic chemical-thermal disequilibrium Delta_T_blind = max(T_cat, T_chalc, 0.85*T_qtz) - max(T_meas, 15). Back-projecting Delta_T_blind and tufa-decontaminated silica sinter/explosion-crater density up the piezometric/topographic gradient onto buried basement steps (B15 depth_to_base_surf), notched for USGS GeoDAWN 400 m E-W flight-line corrugations (Contract G16PC00016) and upward-continuation persistence (TMI_up150) plus fold-safe visible fault slip-rate (slip_mm_yr) tip-propagation deficits, isolates buried permeable fault conduits.
named_non_fault_mimics: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-agitated shoreline tufa mounds (~1,330 m Sehoo and ~1,555 m highstand shorelines; 158 Tufa/Tufa-travertine records in Paleo_geothermal_final.csv previously conflated with hydrothermal sinter)
USGS GeoDAWN Area-2 400 m (4 px) N90E aeromagnetic/radiometric traverse-line levelling corrugation and 150 m / 200 m basin-to-range hybrid drape transition artifacts
Flat basin-floor playa evaporite / smectite pans producing broad shallow MT conductivity highs (B17 cond_surf) over >1,200 m sediment fill without a basement density/depth step

experiments.Control: h88_adhr_b12_ctrl: PHYS-44 + VIS-23 (corrected B12 det_elev scarp geometry + trace_segments_utm11.csv) dual-expectation LightGBM + Bayesian completeness fusion

experiments.Exp02: bgcd_slip_joint83: Single 83-channel joint dual-expectation model (PHYS-44 + BGCD-13 + VIS-23 + 3 fold-safe visible slip-rate channels) + completeness fusion (min_spacing_px=2.35)
experiments.Exp03: h88_bgcd: Distance-adaptive Log-Odds Product-of-Experts pooling the 83-ch slip-structural specialist, 57-ch BGCD blind-geothermal specialist, and 44/67-ch baseline + ridge Dinkelbach allocation (min_spacing_px=2.35), with stratified share_gt25>=0.35 sensitivity logged alongside
